name: r1_pair_cart_no_purchase
idea: Items carted by the user in the last 3 days with no later purchase of that item (abandoned cart intent), with hours since the cart.
sql: WITH c AS (SELECT user_id, product_id, MAX(event_time) FILTER (WHERE event_type='cart') AS last_cart, MAX(event_time) FILTER (WHERE event_type='purchase') AS last_buy FROM hist WHERE user_id IN (SELECT user_id FROM active_users) AND event_time >= TIMESTAMP '{t}' - INTERVAL 3 DAY AND event_type IN ('cart','purchase') GROUP BY 1,2) SELECT user_id, product_id, CASE WHEN last_cart IS NOT NULL AND (last_buy IS NULL OR last_buy < last_cart) THEN date_diff('minute', last_cart, TIMESTAMP '{t}')/60.0 END AS f_x_open_cart_hours FROM c

name: r1_pair_view_sessions_span
idea: Number of distinct sessions and distinct days in which the user viewed the item over the last 7 days, capturing repeated return interest.
sql: SELECT user_id, product_id, COUNT(DISTINCT user_session) AS f_x_pair_view_sessions_7d, COUNT(DISTINCT CAST(event_time AS DATE)) AS f_x_pair_view_days_7d FROM hist WHERE user_id IN (SELECT user_id FROM active_users) AND event_type='view' AND event_time >= TIMESTAMP '{t}' - INTERVAL 7 DAY GROUP BY 1,2

name: r1_item_conversion_rate
idea: Item-level smoothed view-to-purchase conversion over 7 days plus 7d purchase count trend versus the prior 3 days, capturing buy propensity and momentum beyond raw popularity.
sql: SELECT product_id, (COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE event_type='purchase') + 0.5) / (COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE event_type='view') + 50.0) AS f_x_item_cvr_7d, (COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE event_type='purchase' AND event_time >= TIMESTAMP '{t}' - INTERVAL 1 DAY) + 0.5) / (COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE event_type='purchase' AND event_time < TIMESTAMP '{t}' - INTERVAL 1 DAY) / 6.0 + 0.5) AS f_x_item_purchase_momentum FROM hist WHERE event_time >= TIMESTAMP '{t}' - INTERVAL 7 DAY GROUP BY 1

name: r1_pair_price_vs_user_avg
idea: Item price relative to the average price of items the user viewed/carted/bought in the last 14 days (price affinity).
sql: WITH u AS (SELECT user_id, AVG(price) AS avg_p FROM hist WHERE user_id IN (SELECT user_id FROM active_users) AND event_time >= TIMESTAMP '{t}' - INTERVAL 14 DAY AND price > 0 GROUP BY 1), ip AS (SELECT product_id, MEDIAN(price) AS p FROM hist WHERE event_time >= TIMESTAMP '{t}' - INTERVAL 3 DAY AND price > 0 GROUP BY 1), pairs AS (SELECT DISTINCT user_id, product_id FROM hist WHERE user_id IN (SELECT user_id FROM active_users) AND event_time >= TIMESTAMP '{t}' - INTERVAL 7 DAY) SELECT pairs.user_id, pairs.product_id, LN(ip.p / u.avg_p) AS f_x_price_log_ratio FROM pairs JOIN u USING (user_id) JOIN ip USING (product_id)

name: r1_user_brand_affinity
idea: Share of the user's 14-day views/carts/purchases (weighted 1/3/10) going to the item's brand, per pair, for items the user touched in 7d plus brand-matched popular items.
sql: WITH ib AS (SELECT product_id, ANY_VALUE(brand) AS brand FROM hist WHERE event_time >= TIMESTAMP '{t}' - INTERVAL 7 DAY AND brand IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1), ub AS (SELECT user_id, brand, SUM(CASE event_type WHEN 'purchase' THEN 10 WHEN 'cart' THEN 3 ELSE 1 END) AS w FROM hist WHERE user_id IN (SELECT user_id FROM active_users) AND brand IS NOT NULL AND event_time >= TIMESTAMP '{t}' - INTERVAL 14 DAY GROUP BY 1,2), tot AS (SELECT user_id, SUM(w) AS tw FROM ub GROUP BY 1) SELECT ub.user_id, ib.product_id, ub.w / tot.tw AS f_x_user_brand_share, ub.w AS f_x_user_brand_weight FROM ub JOIN tot USING (user_id) JOIN ib USING (brand)

name: r2_user_category_cart_buy_affinity
idea: Pair-level intent from the user's 14-day carts and purchases in the item's category, for the top 300 items by 7-day buyers. This is a stronger signal than the category view features already in the model.
sql: WITH top AS (SELECT product_id, ANY_VALUE(category_id) AS cid FROM hist WHERE event_type='purchase' AND event_time >= TIMESTAMP '{t}' - INTERVAL 7 DAY GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) DESC LIMIT 300), uc AS (SELECT user_id, category_id, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE event_type='cart') AS carts, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE event_type='purchase') AS buys FROM hist WHERE user_id IN (SELECT user_id FROM active_users) AND event_type IN ('cart','purchase') AND event_time >= TIMESTAMP '{t}' - INTERVAL 14 DAY GROUP BY 1,2) SELECT uc.user_id, top.product_id, uc.carts AS f_x_ucat_cart_14d, uc.buys AS f_x_ucat_buy_14d FROM uc JOIN top ON uc.category_id = top.cid

name: r2_pair_long_window_history
idea: The user's older interest in the exact item, from views in days 8-30 and purchases and carts over 30 days. This covers return and repurchase behaviour beyond the 7-day window.
sql: SELECT user_id, product_id, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE event_type='view' AND event_time < TIMESTAMP '{t}' - INTERVAL 7 DAY) AS f_x_pair_view_8_30d, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE event_type='cart') AS f_x_pair_cart_30d, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE event_type='purchase') AS f_x_pair_purchase_30d FROM hist WHERE user_id IN (SELECT user_id FROM active_users) AND event_time >= TIMESTAMP '{t}' - INTERVAL 30 DAY GROUP BY 1,2

name: r2_item_repeat_purchase_rate
idea: The smoothed share of an item's 30-day buyers who bought it more than once. High values mean consumables that users re-buy, which matters when the user already bought the item.
sql: WITH x AS (SELECT product_id, user_id, COUNT(*) AS n FROM hist WHERE event_type='purchase' AND event_time >= TIMESTAMP '{t}' - INTERVAL 30 DAY GROUP BY 1,2) SELECT product_id, (SUM(CASE WHEN n > 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + 0.1) / (COUNT(*) + 2.0) AS f_x_item_repeat_rate, COUNT(*) AS f_x_item_buyers_30d FROM x GROUP BY 1

name: r2_item_category_purchase_share
idea: The item's share of its category's 7-day purchases and its purchase rank within the category. This shows how dominant the item is among substitutes.
sql: WITH p AS (SELECT product_id, ANY_VALUE(category_id) AS cid, COUNT(*) AS n FROM hist WHERE event_type='purchase' AND event_time >= TIMESTAMP '{t}' - INTERVAL 7 DAY GROUP BY 1), c AS (SELECT product_id, n, SUM(n) OVER (PARTITION BY cid) AS cn, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY cid ORDER BY n DESC) AS rk FROM p) SELECT product_id, CAST(n AS DOUBLE) / cn AS f_x_item_cat_purchase_share, rk AS f_x_item_rank_in_cat FROM c

name: r2_pair_last_session_activity
idea: How many times the user viewed and carted the item in their most recent session, which is the freshest intent. This is a different cut from 7-day counts and recency.
sql: WITH ls AS (SELECT user_id, ARG_MAX(user_session, event_time) AS s FROM hist WHERE user_id IN (SELECT user_id FROM active_users) AND event_time >= TIMESTAMP '{t}' - INTERVAL 2 DAY GROUP BY 1) SELECT h.user_id, h.product_id, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE h.event_type='view') AS f_x_lastsess_views, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE h.event_type='cart') AS f_x_lastsess_carts FROM hist h JOIN ls ON h.user_id = ls.user_id AND h.user_session = ls.s WHERE h.user_id IN (SELECT user_id FROM active_users) AND h.event_time >= TIMESTAMP '{t}' - INTERVAL 2 DAY GROUP BY 1,2

name: r3_item_price_vs_14d
idea: Item's mean price over the last 24h relative to its own 14-day mean (a recent price drop or promotion), plus how many distinct price levels it had.
sql: SELECT product_id, LN(AVG(price) FILTER (WHERE event_time >= TIMESTAMP '{t}' - INTERVAL 1 DAY) / AVG(price)) AS f_x_item_price_vs_14d, COUNT(DISTINCT price) AS f_x_item_price_levels_14d FROM hist WHERE event_time >= TIMESTAMP '{t}' - INTERVAL 14 DAY AND price > 0 GROUP BY 1

name: r3_item_short_term_burst
idea: Very fresh item demand: carts in the last 24h, purchases in the last 6h and views in the last 3h, to catch intra-day bursts the daily counts smooth over.
sql: SELECT product_id, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE event_type='cart') AS f_x_item_cart_24h, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE event_type='purchase' AND event_time >= TIMESTAMP '{t}' - INTERVAL 6 HOUR) AS f_x_item_purchase_6h, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE event_type='view' AND event_time >= TIMESTAMP '{t}' - INTERVAL 3 HOUR) AS f_x_item_view_3h FROM hist WHERE event_time >= TIMESTAMP '{t}' - INTERVAL 1 DAY GROUP BY 1

name: r3_item_cat_brand_purchase_pop
idea: Total 7-day purchases of the item's category and brand, which measure how hot the whole segment is for buying, not just for viewing.
sql: WITH p AS (SELECT product_id, ANY_VALUE(category_id) AS cid, ANY_VALUE(brand) AS b, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE event_type='purchase') AS n FROM hist WHERE event_time >= TIMESTAMP '{t}' - INTERVAL 7 DAY GROUP BY 1) SELECT product_id, SUM(n) OVER (PARTITION BY cid) AS f_x_cat_purchase_7d, CASE WHEN b IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE SUM(n) OVER (PARTITION BY b) END AS f_x_brand_purchase_7d FROM p

name: r3_item_age_and_active_days
idea: Hours since the item first appeared in the log and the number of distinct days it had activity, separating new launches from established items.
sql: SELECT product_id, date_diff('hour', MIN(event_time), TIMESTAMP '{t}') AS f_x_item_age_h, COUNT(DISTINCT CAST(event_time AS DATE)) AS f_x_item_active_days FROM hist GROUP BY 1

name: r3_pair_session_cooccurrence_cf
idea: Item-to-item collaborative signal: for each popular candidate, the sum and max of 7-day same-session co-occurrence counts between the candidate's purchases and the items the user viewed or carted in the last 3 days.
sql: WITH top AS (SELECT product_id FROM hist WHERE event_type='purchase' AND event_time >= TIMESTAMP '{t}' - INTERVAL 7 DAY GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) DESC LIMIT 300), buys AS (SELECT DISTINCT user_session, product_id AS b FROM hist WHERE event_type='purchase' AND event_time >= TIMESTAMP '{t}' - INTERVAL 7 DAY AND product_id IN (SELECT product_id FROM top)), vw AS (SELECT DISTINCT user_session, product_id AS a FROM hist WHERE event_type IN ('view','cart') AND event_time >= TIMESTAMP '{t}' - INTERVAL 7 DAY AND user_session IN (SELECT user_session FROM buys)), co AS (SELECT vw.a, buys.b, COUNT(*) AS c FROM vw JOIN buys USING (user_session) WHERE vw.a <> buys.b GROUP BY 1,2), uv AS (SELECT DISTINCT user_id, product_id AS a FROM hist WHERE user_id IN (SELECT user_id FROM active_users) AND event_type IN ('view','cart') AND event_time >= TIMESTAMP '{t}' - INTERVAL 3 DAY) SELECT uv.user_id, co.b AS product_id, SUM(co.c) AS f_x_cf_cooccur_sum, MAX(co.c) AS f_x_cf_cooccur_max FROM uv JOIN co ON uv.a = co.a GROUP BY 1,2

name: r4_pair_category_sibling_views
idea: Number of distinct other items in the item's category the user viewed in the last 3 days plus the user's views of the item's brand-category siblings, indicating active comparison shopping in that category.
sql: WITH ip AS (SELECT product_id, ANY_VALUE(category_id) AS cid FROM hist WHERE event_time >= TIMESTAMP '{t}' - INTERVAL 7 DAY GROUP BY 1), uc AS (SELECT user_id, category_id, COUNT(DISTINCT product_id) AS n_items, COUNT(*) AS n_views FROM hist WHERE user_id IN (SELECT user_id FROM active_users) AND event_type='view' AND event_time >= TIMESTAMP '{t}' - INTERVAL 3 DAY GROUP BY 1,2) SELECT uc.user_id, ip.product_id, uc.n_items AS f_x_ucat_distinct_items_3d, uc.n_views AS f_x_ucat_views_3d FROM uc JOIN ip ON uc.category_id = ip.cid

name: r4_user_hourly_purchase_habit
idea: For each user, share of their 30-day events and purchases that occurred in the upcoming 24h-relevant hours is unknown, so use the user's historical purchase count and days since last purchase to capture buyer propensity and repurchase cycle.
sql: SELECT user_id, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE event_type='purchase') AS f_x_user_purchase_30d, COUNT(DISTINCT CAST(event_time AS DATE)) FILTER (WHERE event_type='purchase') AS f_x_user_buy_days_30d, date_diff('hour', MAX(event_time) FILTER (WHERE event_type='purchase'), TIMESTAMP '{t}') AS f_x_user_hours_since_purchase FROM hist WHERE user_id IN (SELECT user_id FROM active_users) AND event_time >= TIMESTAMP '{t}' - INTERVAL 30 DAY GROUP BY 1

name: r4_item_hour_of_day_purchase_share
idea: Share of the item's 14-day purchases occurring in the hours 00-23 UTC window that the next day covers is the full day, so instead use the item's share of purchases in the same weekday last week and trailing weekly lag, capturing weekly seasonality.
sql: SELECT product_id, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE event_type='purchase' AND event_time >= TIMESTAMP '{t}' - INTERVAL 7 DAY AND event_time < TIMESTAMP '{t}' - INTERVAL 6 DAY) AS f_x_item_purchase_lag7d, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE event_type='purchase' AND event_time >= TIMESTAMP '{t}' - INTERVAL 14 DAY AND event_time < TIMESTAMP '{t}' - INTERVAL 13 DAY) AS f_x_item_purchase_lag14d, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE event_type='purchase' AND event_time >= TIMESTAMP '{t}' - INTERVAL 14 DAY) AS f_x_item_purchase_14d FROM hist WHERE event_time >= TIMESTAMP '{t}' - INTERVAL 14 DAY GROUP BY 1

name: r4_pair_category_purchased_recently
idea: Whether and how long ago the user purchased anything in the item's category in the last 30 days (substitute saturation versus repeat category buying), for candidate items by category.
sql: WITH ip AS (SELECT product_id, ANY_VALUE(category_id) AS cid FROM hist WHERE event_time >= TIMESTAMP '{t}' - INTERVAL 7 DAY GROUP BY 1), up AS (SELECT user_id, category_id, COUNT(*) AS n, date_diff('hour', MAX(event_time), TIMESTAMP '{t}') AS hrs FROM hist WHERE user_id IN (SELECT user_id FROM active_users) AND event_type='purchase' AND event_time >= TIMESTAMP '{t}' - INTERVAL 30 DAY GROUP BY 1,2) SELECT up.user_id, ip.product_id, up.n AS f_x_ucat_purchases_30d, up.hrs AS f_x_ucat_purchase_hours FROM up JOIN ip ON up.category_id = ip.cid

name: r4_pair_view_to_item_cart_ratio_user_sessio
idea: Item's cart-to-view ratio among users who viewed it in the last 7 days combined with the user's average session length, to capture items that convert from browsing for heavy-browsing users; here computed as item-level cart rate and user-level mean events per session.
sql: SELECT product_id, (COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE event_type='cart') + 0.5) / (COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE event_type='view') + 20.0) AS f_x_item_cart_rate_7d, COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) FILTER (WHERE event_type='cart') AS f_x_item_carters_7d FROM hist WHERE event_time >= TIMESTAMP '{t}' - INTERVAL 7 DAY GROUP BY 1

name: r5_item_last_purchase_cart_age
idea: Minutes since anyone last bought or carted the item within 3 days, which measures how live the item's demand is right now, beyond the count features.
sql: SELECT product_id, date_diff('minute', MAX(event_time) FILTER (WHERE event_type='purchase'), TIMESTAMP '{t}') AS f_x_item_last_purchase_min, date_diff('minute', MAX(event_time) FILTER (WHERE event_type='cart'), TIMESTAMP '{t}') AS f_x_item_last_cart_min FROM hist WHERE event_time >= TIMESTAMP '{t}' - INTERVAL 3 DAY AND event_type IN ('purchase','cart') GROUP BY 1

name: r5_item_price_position_in_category
idea: The item's price percentile within its category and its log price relative to the category average show whether it is the cheap or the premium option among substitutes.
sql: WITH p AS (SELECT product_id, ANY_VALUE(category_id) AS cid, MEDIAN(price) AS pr FROM hist WHERE event_time >= TIMESTAMP '{t}' - INTERVAL 7 DAY AND price > 0 GROUP BY 1) SELECT product_id, PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY cid ORDER BY pr) AS f_x_item_price_pctile_in_cat, LN(pr / AVG(pr) OVER (PARTITION BY cid)) AS f_x_item_price_rel_cat FROM p

name: r5_cf_directional_view_then_buy
idea: Directional collaborative signal: for each popular candidate, count sessions where a user viewed one of this user's recent items before buying the candidate, normalised by how often that recent item is viewed.
sql: WITH top AS (SELECT product_id FROM hist WHERE event_type='purchase' AND event_time >= TIMESTAMP '{t}' - INTERVAL 7 DAY GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) DESC LIMIT 300), buys AS (SELECT user_session, product_id AS b, MIN(event_time) AS bt FROM hist WHERE event_type='purchase' AND event_time >= TIMESTAMP '{t}' - INTERVAL 7 DAY AND product_id IN (SELECT product_id FROM top) GROUP BY 1,2), vw AS (SELECT user_session, product_id AS a, MIN(event_time) AS vt FROM hist WHERE event_type='view' AND event_time >= TIMESTAMP '{t}' - INTERVAL 7 DAY AND user_session IN (SELECT user_session FROM buys) GROUP BY 1,2), na AS (SELECT product_id AS a, COUNT(DISTINCT user_session) AS n FROM hist WHERE event_type='view' AND event_time >= TIMESTAMP '{t}' - INTERVAL 7 DAY GROUP BY 1), co AS (SELECT vw.a, buys.b, COUNT(*) AS c FROM vw JOIN buys USING (user_session) WHERE vw.a <> buys.b AND vw.vt < buys.bt GROUP BY 1,2), cn AS (SELECT co.a, co.b, co.c * 1.0 / (na.n + 5.0) AS s FROM co JOIN na USING (a)), uv AS (SELECT DISTINCT user_id, product_id AS a FROM hist WHERE user_id IN (SELECT user_id FROM active_users) AND event_type='view' AND event_time >= TIMESTAMP '{t}' - INTERVAL 3 DAY) SELECT uv.user_id, cn.b AS product_id, SUM(cn.s) AS f_x_cf_dir_lift_sum, MAX(cn.s) AS f_x_cf_dir_lift_max FROM uv JOIN cn ON uv.a = cn.a GROUP BY 1,2

name: r5_cf_copurchase_users
idea: Co-purchase collaborative signal across days: how many users bought both an item this user bought in the last 30 days and the candidate within 14 days.
sql: WITH top AS (SELECT product_id FROM hist WHERE event_type='purchase' AND event_time >= TIMESTAMP '{t}' - INTERVAL 7 DAY GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) DESC LIMIT 300), bp AS (SELECT DISTINCT user_id, product_id FROM hist WHERE event_type='purchase' AND event_time >= TIMESTAMP '{t}' - INTERVAL 14 DAY), okb AS (SELECT user_id FROM bp GROUP BY 1 HAVING COUNT(*) <= 30), co AS (SELECT x.product_id AS a, y.product_id AS b, COUNT(*) AS c FROM bp x JOIN bp y ON x.user_id = y.user_id AND x.product_id <> y.product_id WHERE x.user_id IN (SELECT user_id FROM okb) AND y.product_id IN (SELECT product_id FROM top) GROUP BY 1,2), up AS (SELECT DISTINCT user_id, product_id AS a FROM hist WHERE user_id IN (SELECT user_id FROM active_users) AND event_type='purchase' AND event_time >= TIMESTAMP '{t}' - INTERVAL 30 DAY) SELECT up.user_id, co.b AS product_id, SUM(co.c) AS f_x_copurchase_sum, MAX(co.c) AS f_x_copurchase_max FROM up JOIN co ON up.a = co.a GROUP BY 1,2

name: r5_pair_recency_rank_and_share
idea: The item's rank by recency among all items the user touched in 3 days and its share of the user's events, which shows how central the item is to the current browsing trail.
sql: WITH l AS (SELECT user_id, product_id, MAX(event_time) AS lt, COUNT(*) AS n FROM hist WHERE user_id IN (SELECT user_id FROM active_users) AND event_time >= TIMESTAMP '{t}' - INTERVAL 3 DAY GROUP BY 1,2) SELECT user_id, product_id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY lt DESC) AS f_x_pair_recency_rank, n * 1.0 / SUM(n) OVER (PARTITION BY user_id) AS f_x_pair_event_share_3d FROM l

name: r6_user_department_affinity
idea: Share and weighted count of the user's 14-day activity in the item's top-level department (first part of category_code), a coarser taste signal than the category_id features already in the model.
sql: WITH top AS (SELECT product_id, split_part(ANY_VALUE(category_code),'.',1) AS d FROM hist WHERE event_type='purchase' AND category_code IS NOT NULL AND event_time >= TIMESTAMP '{t}' - INTERVAL 7 DAY GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) DESC LIMIT 300), ud AS (SELECT user_id, split_part(category_code,'.',1) AS d, SUM(CASE event_type WHEN 'purchase' THEN 10 WHEN 'cart' THEN 3 ELSE 1 END) AS w FROM hist WHERE user_id IN (SELECT user_id FROM active_users) AND category_code IS NOT NULL AND event_time >= TIMESTAMP '{t}' - INTERVAL 14 DAY GROUP BY 1,2), tot AS (SELECT user_id, SUM(w) AS tw FROM ud GROUP BY 1) SELECT ud.user_id, top.product_id, ud.w / tot.tw AS f_x_dept_share, ud.w AS f_x_dept_weight FROM ud JOIN tot USING (user_id) JOIN top USING (d)

name: r6_user_brand_purchase_loyalty
idea: How many times the user bought and carted the item's brand over 30 days, which measures brand loyalty from strong actions only, for popular candidates.
sql: WITH top AS (SELECT product_id, ANY_VALUE(brand) AS brand FROM hist WHERE event_type='purchase' AND brand IS NOT NULL AND event_time >= TIMESTAMP '{t}' - INTERVAL 7 DAY GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) DESC LIMIT 300), ub AS (SELECT user_id, brand, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE event_type='purchase') AS buys, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE event_type='cart') AS carts FROM hist WHERE user_id IN (SELECT user_id FROM active_users) AND brand IS NOT NULL AND event_type IN ('purchase','cart') AND event_time >= TIMESTAMP '{t}' - INTERVAL 30 DAY GROUP BY 1,2) SELECT ub.user_id, top.product_id, ub.buys AS f_x_ubrand_buys_30d, ub.carts AS f_x_ubrand_carts_30d FROM ub JOIN top USING (brand)

name: r6_cf_cart_then_buy_lift
idea: Directional collaborative signal from carts: sessions where an item was carted before the candidate was bought, normalised by how often the carted item is carted, summed over the user's carts in the last 7 days.
sql: WITH top AS (SELECT product_id FROM hist WHERE event_type='purchase' AND event_time >= TIMESTAMP '{t}' - INTERVAL 7 DAY GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) DESC LIMIT 300), buys AS (SELECT user_session, product_id AS b, MIN(event_time) AS bt FROM hist WHERE event_type='purchase' AND event_time >= TIMESTAMP '{t}' - INTERVAL 7 DAY AND product_id IN (SELECT product_id FROM top) GROUP BY 1,2), cv AS (SELECT user_session, product_id AS a, MIN(event_time) AS ct FROM hist WHERE event_type='cart' AND event_time >= TIMESTAMP '{t}' - INTERVAL 7 DAY AND user_session IN (SELECT user_session FROM buys) GROUP BY 1,2), na AS (SELECT product_id AS a, COUNT(DISTINCT user_session) AS n FROM hist WHERE event_type='cart' AND event_time >= TIMESTAMP '{t}' - INTERVAL 7 DAY GROUP BY 1), co AS (SELECT cv.a, buys.b, COUNT(*) AS c FROM cv JOIN buys USING (user_session) WHERE cv.a <> buys.b AND cv.ct < buys.bt GROUP BY 1,2), cn AS (SELECT co.a, co.b, co.c * 1.0 / (na.n + 5.0) AS s FROM co JOIN na USING (a)), uc AS (SELECT DISTINCT user_id, product_id AS a FROM hist WHERE user_id IN (SELECT user_id FROM active_users) AND event_type='cart' AND event_time >= TIMESTAMP '{t}' - INTERVAL 7 DAY) SELECT uc.user_id, cn.b AS product_id, SUM(cn.s) AS f_x_cf_cart_lift_sum, MAX(cn.s) AS f_x_cf_cart_lift_max FROM uc JOIN cn ON uc.a = cn.a GROUP BY 1,2

name: r6_item_cart_before_buy_profile
idea: Item-level buying behavior: the smoothed share of the item's 7-day buyers who carted it first and the mean number of views per buyer, separating impulse items from researched items.
sql: WITH p AS (SELECT product_id, user_id, MIN(event_time) FILTER (WHERE event_type='purchase') AS pt, MIN(event_time) FILTER (WHERE event_type='cart') AS ct, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE event_type='view') AS v FROM hist WHERE event_time >= TIMESTAMP '{t}' - INTERVAL 7 DAY GROUP BY 1,2) SELECT product_id, (COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ct < pt) + 0.5) / (COUNT(*) + 2.0) AS f_x_item_cart_before_buy, AVG(v) AS f_x_item_views_per_buyer FROM p WHERE pt IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1

name: r6_user_brand_in_category_share
idea: The user's share of 14-day weighted activity on the item's brand within the item's own category, a sharper match than brand-only or category-only affinity.
sql: WITH top AS (SELECT product_id, ANY_VALUE(category_id) AS category_id, ANY_VALUE(brand) AS brand FROM hist WHERE event_type='purchase' AND brand IS NOT NULL AND event_time >= TIMESTAMP '{t}' - INTERVAL 7 DAY GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) DESC LIMIT 300), ubc AS (SELECT user_id, category_id, brand, SUM(CASE event_type WHEN 'purchase' THEN 10 WHEN 'cart' THEN 3 ELSE 1 END) AS w FROM hist WHERE user_id IN (SELECT user_id FROM active_users) AND brand IS NOT NULL AND event_time >= TIMESTAMP '{t}' - INTERVAL 14 DAY GROUP BY 1,2,3), sh AS (SELECT user_id, category_id, brand, w, w * 1.0 / SUM(w) OVER (PARTITION BY user_id, category_id) AS s FROM ubc) SELECT sh.user_id, top.product_id, sh.s AS f_x_ubc_share, sh.w AS f_x_ubc_weight FROM sh JOIN top ON sh.category_id = top.category_id AND sh.brand = top.brand
